informal_statement:
For \(R>0\),
\[
0<\theta<\pi,
\]
natural \(N>0\), and any natural \(i\), the distance between consecutive circle partition points is
\[
2R\sin(\theta/N).
\]
reason: Source `FrontierPerimeter.lean:185-207`: The exact consecutive chord distance holds for every natural index, not only those inside the chosen finite partition; the sine sign is justified by the angle bounds.
